reports.name: Inwarded Raw Material after Inspection
reports.queryTemplate:
select DATE_FORMAT(RI_DATE, '%d-%m-%Y') as GrnDate, RI_REPORTNO as GrnNumber, RD_BATCHNO as BatchNo, MM_RawMtPartNo as RawMaterial, MT_Name as MaterialType, RD_ACCEPTEDQTY as Quantity, ss_Name as Supplier
 from rm_inwarddetails left join rm_inwardmaster on RI_ID = RD_RIID
 left join materialmaster on RD_RMID = MM_Id
 left join supplier on RI_SUPPLIERID = ss_Id
 left join materialtypemaster on MM_mtId=mt_id
 where month(RI_DATE) = {month} and year(RI_DATE) = {year} and RI_REPORTNO like 'INV%' and RI_INSPECTIONYN = 'Y'  and RI_MOVEMENT='I' and RI_MOVEMENTTYPE=1;

reports.name: Current Raw Material Stock
reports.queryTemplate:
select * from (SELECT RD_BATCHNO as 'Batch No',
		MM_RawMtPartNo as 'Raw Material',
        MT_Name as 'Material Type',
		round(SUM(CASE WHEN ri_movement = 'I' THEN rd_qty ELSE 0 END)
			- SUM(CASE WHEN ri_movement = 'O' THEN rd_qty ELSE 0 END), 2 )AS Qty
	FROM rm_inwarddetails , rm_inwardmaster, materialmaster, materialtypemaster
    where rd_riid=ri_id and RD_RMID = MM_Id and MM_mtId = MT_Id
    group by RD_BATCHNO, RD_RMID order by Qty)t where Qty != 0;

reports.name: Monthly Material Movement
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(RI_DATE, '%d-%m-%Y') as 'Date', US_FirstName as 'User', RD_BATCHNO as 'Batch No', MM_RawMtPartNo as 'Raw Material', CO_PARTNO as 'Part No', RD_QTY 'Qty', 
CASE when RI_MOVEMENT = 'I' then 'Inward' else 'Outward' end as Movement, ML_DESCRIPTION as 'Purpose', 
CASE when RI_SUPPLIERID = 0 then 'In House' else ss_Name end as Supplier FROM 
rm_inwardmaster 
left join supplier on RI_SUPPLIERID = ss_Id, rm_inwarddetails 
left join components on RD_COMPID = CO_ID
left join materialmaster on RD_RMID = MM_Id
, rm_movements , users
where RI_ID = RD_RIID and RI_MOVEMENTTYPE = ML_ID and RI_CREATEDBY = US_ID and
 month(RI_DATE) ={month} and year(RI_DATE) = {year}
order by RI_DATE desc ,RD_RMID, RD_BATCHNO;

reports.name: List of Distinct Raw Materials
reports.queryTemplate:
select MM_RawMtPartNo as RawMaterial ,MT_Name as Material ,MM_Thickness as Thickness ,MM_StripWidth as Width,hm_name as Hardness,GM_Name as Grade from materialmaster
	left join grademaster on MM_gmId=gm_id
	left join hardnessmaster on MM_hmId=HM_Id
	left join materialtypemaster on MM_mtId=mt_id where mm_activeyn='Y';

reports.name: Machines
reports.queryTemplate: SELECT MCM_Name as Machine, MCM_Make as Make, MCM_Capacity as Capacity FROM machinemaster where MCM_ACTIVEYN = 'Y';

reports.name: Suppliers
reports.queryTemplate: select ss_name Supplier,st_name Type from supplier left join suppliertype on ss_SupplierType= st_id where ss_activeyn='Y';

reports.name: Users
reports.queryTemplate: SELECT US_FirstName as 'First Name', US_LastName as 'Last Name', US_Login as Login, US_EmpID as 'Emp Id' FROM users where US_CurrentYn = 'Y';

reports.name: Distinct Parts
reports.queryTemplate:
select cu_name as 'Parent Customer', CO_PARTNO as 'Part No', CO_PARTNAME as 'Part Name', mt_name as 'Material', CO_WEIGHT as Weight, CO_WIDTH as Width, CO_LENGTH as Length, CO_REVISION as Revision, gm_name as Grade ,pl_name as Plating ,ft_name as 'Finish Type', CO_MICRON as Micron from components c
	left join customer on CO_CUSTID=cu_id
    left join materialtypemaster on co_materialtypeid= mt_id
    left join grademaster on CO_GRADEID=gm_id
    left join plating on CO_ELECTROPLATING=pl_id
    left join finishtype on CO_FINISH=ft_id
    where co_id in (select distinct(CO_PARENTID) from components where CO_ACTIVEYN= 'Y' );

reports.name: Tools
reports.queryTemplate:
select CT_TOOLNO as 'Tool No', co_partno as 'Part No', CO_PARTNAME as 'Part Name', MM_RawMtPartNo as 'Raw Material', CT_PITCH as Pitch, CT_NO_OF_CAVITY as Cavity from components_tool ct
	 left join components on CT_COMPID=CO_ID
     left join materialmaster on CT_RMID=mm_id    
     left join controlprocess on ct_cpid = cp_id
    where CT_ACTIVEYN='Y';

reports.name: Customers
reports.queryTemplate: select CU_Name as Customer from customer where CU_Status = 'R';

reports.name: Customer Part Tools
reports.queryTemplate:
select cu_name as Customer ,co_partno as 'Part No', CO_PARTNAME as 'Part Name' , t.tool_list as 'Tool No'
from  components
 left join customer on cu_status ='R' and CO_CUSTID= cu_id
left join ( select CT_COMPID, count(ct_toolno) tcount,GROUP_CONCAT(ct_toolno ORDER BY ct_toolno SEPARATOR '::') AS tool_list,
GROUP_CONCAT(ct_id ORDER BY ct_id SEPARATOR '::') AS toolid_list
 from components_tool where ct_activeyn='Y' group by CT_COMPID order by CT_COMPID) t on  t.ct_compid = CO_PARENTID
where CO_ACTIVEYN='Y'
 order by cu_name,cu_id;

reports.name: Monthly Order
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT
  t.partno    AS 'Part No',
  t.total_qty AS 'Total Qty',
  t.day_1     AS 'day 1',
  t.day_2     AS 'day 2',
  t.day_3     AS 'day 3',
  t.day_4     AS 'day 4',
  t.day_5     AS 'day 5',
  t.day_6     AS 'day 6',
  t.day_7     AS 'day 7',
  t.day_8     AS 'day 8',
  t.day_9     AS 'day 9',
  t.day_10    AS 'day 10',
  t.day_11    AS 'day 11',
  t.day_12    AS 'day 12',
  t.day_13    AS 'day 13',
  t.day_14    AS 'day 14',
  t.day_15    AS 'day 15',
  t.day_16    AS 'day 16',
  t.day_17    AS 'day 17',
  t.day_18    AS 'day 18',
  t.day_19    AS 'day 19',
  t.day_20    AS 'day 20',
  t.day_21    AS 'day 21',
  t.day_22    AS 'day 22',
  t.day_23    AS 'day 23',
  t.day_24    AS 'day 24',
  t.day_25    AS 'day 25',
  t.day_26    AS 'day 26',
  t.day_27    AS 'day 27',
  t.day_28    AS 'day 28',
  t.day_29    AS 'day 29',
  t.day_30    AS 'day 30',
  t.day_31    AS 'day 31'
FROM (
  SELECT
    0 AS sort_order,
    'Grand Total' AS partno,
    SUM(sc.CS_QTY) AS total_qty,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 1 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 2 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 3 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_3,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 4 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_4,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 5 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_5,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 6 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_6,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 7 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_7,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 8 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_8,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 9 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_9,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 10 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_10,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 11 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_11,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 12 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_12,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 13 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_13,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 14 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_14,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 15 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_15,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 16 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_16,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 17 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_17,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 18 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_18,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 19 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_19,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 20 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_20,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 21 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_21,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 22 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_22,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 23 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_23,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 24 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_24,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 25 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_25,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 26 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_26,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 27 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_27,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 28 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_28,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 29 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_29,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 30 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_30,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 31 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_31
  FROM schedule_master sm
  JOIN schedule_details sd ON sm.SM_ID = sd.SC_SMID
  JOIN scheduled_customer sc ON sd.SC_ID = sc.CS_SCID
  JOIN components c ON sd.SC_COMPID = c.CO_ID
  WHERE sm.SM_MONTH = {month}
    AND sm.SM_YEAR = {year}
    AND sc.CS_SCHEDULESTATE IN (1, 2)

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    1 AS sort_order,
    c.CO_PARTNO AS partno,
    SUM(sc.CS_QTY) AS total_qty,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 1 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 2 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 3 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_3,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 4 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_4,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 5 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_5,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 6 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_6,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 7 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_7,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 8 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_8,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 9 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_9,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 10 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_10,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 11 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_11,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 12 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_12,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 13 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_13,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 14 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_14,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 15 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_15,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 16 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_16,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 17 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_17,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 18 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_18,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 19 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_19,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 20 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_20,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 21 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_21,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 22 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_22,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 23 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_23,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 24 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_24,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 25 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_25,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 26 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_26,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 27 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_27,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 28 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_28,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 29 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_29,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 30 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_30,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DAY(sc.CS_DATE) = 31 THEN sc.CS_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS day_31
  FROM schedule_master sm
  JOIN schedule_details sd ON sm.SM_ID = sd.SC_SMID
  JOIN scheduled_customer sc ON sd.SC_ID = sc.CS_SCID
  JOIN components c ON sd.SC_COMPID = c.CO_ID
  WHERE sm.SM_MONTH = {month}
    AND sm.SM_YEAR = {year}
    AND sc.CS_SCHEDULESTATE IN (1, 2)
  GROUP BY c.CO_PARTNO
) t
ORDER BY t.sort_order, t.partno;

reports.name: Date-wise Monthly Production
reports.queryTemplate:
select DATE_FORMAT(pd_date, '%d-%m-%Y') 'ProductionDate', CO_PARTNO 'Part No', PD_LotNo 'Lot No',MCM_Name Machine, CT_TOOLNO Tool, MM_RawMtPartNo 'Raw MAterial',
pd_batchno 'Batch No', pd_prodqty  'No Of Comp', PD_SFREJECT 'SF Rej(Nos)',PD_SWQTY 'SU Wastage(Nos)',PD_SCRAPQTY 'Scrap(Kg)',PD_QTYKG 'Part Wt(Kg)', round(pd_prodqty/conVal,4) 'Theo RM Kg'
from production_details 
left join machinemaster on MCM_Id= PD_MCID
left join materialmaster on mm_id = pd_rmid
left join components_tool on ct_id =pd_toolid
left join scheduled_production on pd_psid= ps_id
left join components on PS_PARENTCOMPID = CO_ID
left join (
SELECT CT_ID AS ctid,
        ((1 / ((MT_Density * MM_Thickness) * MM_StripWidth)) * ((1000 * CT_NO_OF_CAVITY) / CT_Pitch)) AS conVal
      FROM components_tool
      INNER JOIN materialmaster ON CT_RMID = MM_Id
      INNER JOIN materialtypemaster ON MM_MTID = MT_Id
      WHERE CT_ActiveYN = 'Y' AND CT_PITCH > 0 AND CT_NO_OF_CAVITY > 0) toolConv on ctid = ct_id 
where month(pd_date)= {month} and year(pd_date) = {year}
order by pd_date desc

reports.name: Consolidated-Component Month-wise Production
reports.queryTemplate:
select  CO_PARTNO 'Part No', MM_RawMtPartNo 'Raw Material',
 sum(pd_prodqty)  'No Of Comp', sum(PD_SFREJECT) 'SF Rej',sum(PD_SWQTY) 'SU Wastage',round(sum(PD_SCRAPQTY),2) 'Scrap',round(sum(PD_QTYKG),2) 'RawMaterial(Kg)', round(sum(pd_prodqty/conVal),2) 'Theo RM Kg'
from production_details 
left join materialmaster on mm_id = pd_rmid
left join scheduled_production on pd_psid= ps_id
left join components on PS_PARENTCOMPID = CO_ID
left join components_tool on PD_TOOLID = ct_id
left join (
SELECT CT_ID AS ctid,
        ((1 / ((MT_Density * MM_Thickness) * MM_StripWidth)) * ((1000 * CT_NO_OF_CAVITY) / CT_Pitch)) AS conVal
      FROM components_tool
      INNER JOIN materialmaster ON CT_RMID = MM_Id
      INNER JOIN materialtypemaster ON MM_MTID = MT_Id
      WHERE CT_ActiveYN = 'Y' AND CT_PITCH > 0 AND CT_NO_OF_CAVITY > 0) toolConv on ctid = ct_id 
where month(pd_date)= {month} and year(pd_date) = {year}
group by CO_PARTNO,MM_RawMtPartNo
order by  CO_PARTNO;

reports.name: Distinct Tools with PartNos
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT 
    ct_toolno AS Tool,group_concat( DISTINCT CT_PITCH ORDER BY CT_PITCH SEPARATOR ' ,') as 'Pitch',group_concat( distinct CT_NO_OF_CAVITY order by CT_NO_OF_CAVITY SEPARATOR  '  ,') as 'Cavity', 
    COUNT(*) AS 'Component Count',
        COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN CO_PARTNO END), '') AS Component1,
		COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN CO_PARTNO END), '') AS Component2,
		COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN CO_PARTNO END), '') AS Component3,
        COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 4 THEN CO_PARTNO END), '') AS Component4
FROM (
    SELECT 
        ct_toolno,
        CO_PARTNO,CT_PITCH,CT_NO_OF_CAVITY,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ct_toolno ORDER BY CO_PARTNO) AS rn
    FROM components_tool 
    LEFT JOIN components ON CT_COMPID = CO_ID
    WHERE ct_activeyn = 'Y'
) t
GROUP BY ct_toolno
ORDER BY ct_toolno;

reports.name: Dispatch between dates
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT
  CU_Name AS Customer,
  CO_partNo AS 'Part No',
  CO_partName AS 'Part Name',
  CS_PLANTID AS 'Unit',
  DATE_FORMAT(CS_DATE, '%d-%m-%Y') AS 'Requested Date',
  CS_QTY AS 'Requested Qty',
  SD_LOTSIZE AS 'Dispatched Qty',
  SD_INVOICE AS 'Invoice Number',
  DATE_FORMAT(SD_DISPATCHDATE, '%d-%m-%Y') AS 'Invoice Date'
FROM scheduled_customerdispatch
INNER JOIN scheduled_customer ON SD_CSID = CS_Id
INNER JOIN customer ON CU_Id = CS_CUSTID
INNER JOIN schedule_details ON SC_Id = CS_SCID
INNER JOIN components ON CO_Id = SC_COMPID
INNER JOIN dispatch_status ON DS_Id = SD_Status
WHERE SD_Status = 7
  AND CS_Date BETWEEN {fromDate} AND {toDate};

reports.name: In-House Component Stock
reports.queryTemplate:
select co_partno 'PartNo', 
	MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 2 THEN cs_qty END) AS '1st Forming',
	MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 3 THEN cs_qty END) AS 'Electroplating',
	MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 4 THEN cs_qty END) AS 'Soapwash',
	MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 5 THEN cs_qty END) AS 'Tapping',
	MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 6 THEN cs_qty END) AS 'FG',
	MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 7 THEN cs_qty END) AS '2nd Forming',
	MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 8 THEN cs_qty END) AS '3rd Forming',
	MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 9 THEN cs_qty END) AS 'Etching',
	MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 10 THEN cs_qty END) AS 'Deburring',
	MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 12 THEN cs_qty END) AS 'Laser Welding',
	MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 13 THEN cs_qty END) AS 'Ultrasonic Cleaning',
	MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 14 THEN cs_qty END) AS 'Arcor Coating',
	MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 15 THEN cs_qty END) AS 'Riveting',
	MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 16 THEN cs_qty END) AS 'Brazing',
	MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 17 THEN cs_qty END) AS 'Heat Sealing',
	MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 18 THEN cs_qty END) AS 'Dimpling'
 from(
select co_partno,os_name,os_id,cs_qty from comp_stock 
left join comp_opstages on CS_STAGEID=os_id 
left join components on CS_COMPID= co_id
 where cs_plantid = {plantid})t
 group by co_partno
order by co_partno;

reports.name: QA  Pending Components
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT
    co_partno 'Part No',
    SUM(QAFromSup_pending) AS 'QA Pending from Supplier',
    SUM(ProdQA_pending) AS 'QA Pending from Production',
    SUM(qa_disp_pending) AS 'QA Disposition',
    SUM(rw_pending) AS 'Rework Pending'
FROM (
    -- qaPending from comp_inwardmaster + qa_details
    SELECT CD_COMPID AS comp_id,
           COALESCE(SUM(QD_OFFEREDQTY), 0) AS QAFromSup_pending,
           0 as ProdQA_pending,
           0 AS qa_disp_pending,
           0 AS rw_pending
    FROM comp_inwardmaster
    INNER JOIN comp_inwarddetails ON CM_ID = CD_CMID
    INNER JOIN qa_details ON QD_CMID = CM_ID
    WHERE CM_PLANT = {plantid}
      AND QD_STATUS = 'P'
      AND QD_CRID = 0
    GROUP BY CD_COMPID


union all
-- qa pending from production_details & qa_details
    select PS_PARENTCOMPID AS comp_id,0 as QASup_pending,
           COALESCE(SUM(QD_OFFEREDQTY), 0) AS ProdQA_pending,0 AS qa_disp_pending,
           0 AS rw_pending
	from scheduled_production
	inner join production_details on ps_id = pd_psid
	inner join qa_details on pd_id = qd_pdid
	WHERE pd_plantid =  {plantid}
      AND QD_STATUS = 'P'
      AND QD_CRID = 0
      group by PS_PARENTCOMPID

 
    UNION ALL

    -- qaDispositionPending
    SELECT CR_COMPID AS comp_id,
           0 AS qa_pending,0 as ProdQA_pending,
           COALESCE(SUM(CR_QTY), 0) AS qa_disp_pending,
           0 AS rw_pending
    FROM comp_rejectdetails
    WHERE CR_PLANT =  {plantid}
      AND CR_STATUS = 'P'
    GROUP BY CR_COMPID
    
union all

 SELECT CR_COMPID AS comp_id,
           0 AS qa_pending,0 as ProdQA_pending,
           0 AS qa_disp_pending,
           COALESCE(SUM(CR_QTY) - COALESCE(sum(t.rdQty), 0), 0) AS rw_pending
    FROM comp_rejectdetails
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT RD_CRID AS crId, SUM(RD_QTY) AS rdQty
        FROM comp_rejinvdetails
        INNER JOIN comp_rejinvmaster ON RD_RJID = RJ_ID
        INNER JOIN comp_rejectdetails ON CR_ID = RD_CRID
        WHERE RJ_MOVEMENT = 'O'
          AND CR_PLANT =  {plantid}
          AND CR_STATUS = 'R'
        GROUP BY RD_CRID
    ) t ON t.crId = CR_ID
    WHERE CR_PLANT =  {plantid}
      AND CR_STATUS = 'R'
    GROUP BY CR_COMPID    
) combined left join components on co_id = comp_id
GROUP BY comp_id
order by co_partno;

reports.name: Supplier Component Stock
reports.queryTemplate:
select co_partno 'Part No', 
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 2 THEN compbalance END) AS '1st Forming',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 3 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Electroplating',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 4 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Soapwash',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 5 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Tapping',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 6 THEN compbalance END) AS 'FG',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 7 THEN compbalance END) AS '2nd Forming',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 8 THEN compbalance END) AS '3rd Forming',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 9 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Etching',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 10 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Deburring',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 12 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Laser Welding',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 13 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Ultrasonic Cleaning',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 14 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Arcor Coating',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 15 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Riveting',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 16 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Brazing',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 17 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Heat Sealing',
	MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 18 THEN compbalance END) AS 'Dimpling'
from
 (
select co_id,CO_PARTNO,cd_opstage, COALESCE(
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN cm_movement = 'O' THEN cd_qty
                WHEN cm_movement = 'I' THEN -cd_qty
                ELSE 0
            END
        ), 0
    ) 
    - COALESCE(sum(sd_qty), 0) AS compbalance
    from  comp_inwardmaster, comp_inwarddetails
    left join comp_opstages on cd_opstage=os_id 
	left join components on CD_COMPID= co_id and CO_ACTIVEYN='Y'
    left join comp_scrapdetails   on  sd_source='S' and sd_src=3 and sd_refno=CD_CMID and sd_compid = cd_compid and SD_OPSTAGE= cd_opstage
    where cm_id = cd_cmid and co_id is not null
    group by cd_compid,cd_opstage) t
    where compbalance >0
    group by co_partno
    order by CO_PARTNO;

reports.name: Planned vs Produced Qty
reports.queryTemplate:
select  co_partno 'Part No', CO_PARTNAME 'Part Name',plan.planqty 'Planned Qty' ,prod.prodqty 'Produced Qty'  from schedule_master, 
(select sp.PS_PARENTCOMPID comp,sp.PS_SMID smid,  sum(pd.PD_PRODQTY)  prodqty
from production_details pd, scheduled_production sp  
where ps_id= PD_PSID -- and sp.PS_PARENTCOMPID in (1668)
group by sp.PS_PARENTCOMPID,sp.PS_SMID) prod,
(select PS_PARENTCOMPID comp, ps_smid smid, sum(ps_qty) planqty from scheduled_production sp 
group by PS_PARENTCOMPID,PS_SMID) plan, components
where  SM_MONTH= {month} and sm_year = {year}
and prod.smid=plan.smid
and prod.smid =  sm_id
and prod.comp = plan.comp
and prod.comp = co_id
order by co_partno;

reports.name: SalesOrder vs CustSchedule vs plan vs Produced
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT
  c.CO_PARTNO    AS 'Part No',
  c.CO_PARTNAME  AS 'Part Name',
  COALESCE(so.soQty ,0) AS 'SalesOrder Qty',
  COALESCE(cs.custSchd, 0) AS 'Customer Scheduled',
  COALESCE(pl.planqty, 0)  AS 'Planned Qty',
  COALESCE(pr.prodqty, 0)  AS 'Produced Qty'
FROM schedule_master sm
JOIN (
  SELECT
    sp.PS_PARENTCOMPID AS comp,
    sp.PS_SMID         AS smid,
    SUM(pd.PD_PRODQTY) AS prodqty
  FROM scheduled_production sp
  JOIN production_details pd
    ON pd.PD_PSID = sp.PS_ID
  GROUP BY sp.PS_PARENTCOMPID, sp.PS_SMID
) pr
  ON pr.smid = sm.SM_ID
JOIN (
  SELECT
    sp.PS_PARENTCOMPID AS comp,
    sp.PS_SMID         AS smid,
    SUM(sp.PS_QTY)     AS planqty
  FROM scheduled_production sp
  GROUP BY sp.PS_PARENTCOMPID, sp.PS_SMID
) pl
  ON pl.smid = pr.smid
 AND pl.comp = pr.comp
JOIN components c
  ON c.CO_ID = pr.comp
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    sd.SC_SMID          AS smid,
    c2.CO_PARENTID      AS comp,
    SUM(sd.SC_CUSTQTY)  AS custSchd
  FROM schedule_details sd
  LEFT JOIN components c2
    ON c2.CO_ID = sd.SC_COMPID
  GROUP BY sd.SC_SMID, c2.CO_PARENTID
) cs
  ON cs.smid = sm.SM_ID
 AND cs.comp = pr.comp
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    cc.CO_PARENTID      AS pocomp,
    SUM(so.QTY)         AS soQty,
    MONTH(so.DLV_DATE )   AS pomonth,
    YEAR(so.DLV_DATE )    AS poyear
  FROM sales_order so    
  LEFT JOIN components cc
    ON TRIM(cc.CO_PARTNO) = TRIM(so.PART_NO)
   AND cc.CO_CUSTID = so.CUST_ID and CATEGORY_ID = 1
                  AND SO_TYPE_ID IN (1, 2)
                  AND STATUS_ID IN (1, 7)
  GROUP BY cc.CO_PARENTID, MONTH(so.DLV_DATE), YEAR(so.DLV_DATE)
) so
  ON so.pocomp = pr.comp
 AND so.pomonth = sm.SM_MONTH
 AND so.poyear  = sm.SM_YEAR
WHERE sm.SM_MONTH = {month}
  AND sm.SM_YEAR  = {year}
ORDER BY c.CO_PARTNO;

reports.name: RM Consumption
reports.queryTemplate:
select inQ.*, remq.RemQty ,partnos as 'Produced Parts', RMForProduction from 
(select  MM_RawMtPartNo RawMaterial,RD_BATCHNO batch,ri_date 'InwardDt', RD_ACCEPTEDQTY 'inwardQty' 
from rm_inwarddetails
	 join rm_inwardmaster on rd_riid= ri_id and month(ri_date)= {month} and year(RI_DATE)= {year} and RI_MOVEMENT='I' and RI_MOVEMENTTYPE=1
     -- left join supplier on RI_SUPPLIERID= ss_id
     left join materialmaster on mm_id = rd_rmid
     group by  MM_RawMtPartNo,RD_BATCHNO, RD_qty,ri_date,rd_id)inQ
  left join
     (select RD_BATCHNO batch,
round(SUM(CASE WHEN ri_movement = 'I' THEN rd_qty ELSE 0 END)- SUM(CASE WHEN ri_movement = 'O' THEN rd_qty ELSE 0 END) ,2)AS RemQty
from rm_inwarddetails
	 join rm_inwardmaster on rd_riid= ri_id 
     group by RD_BATCHNO)remQ on  inQ.batch =remQ.batch
left join (  select pd_batchno batch,group_concat( distinct CO_PARTNO order by CO_PARTNO separator ' , ') partnos, round(sum(PD_PRODQTY/conVal),2)  RMForProduction from production_details
left join scheduled_production plan on pd_psid = plan.ps_id 
left join components on  plan.PS_PARENTCOMPID= co_id
left join 
(SELECT CT_COMPID ,((1 / ((MT_Density * MM_Thickness) * MM_StripWidth)) * ((1000 * CT_NO_OF_CAVITY) / CT_Pitch)) as conVal FROM components_tool
 inner join materialmaster on CT_RMID = MM_Id inner join materialtypemaster on MM_MTID = MT_Id where  CT_ActiveYN='Y' and CT_PPC='Y' and CT_PITCH > 0 
 and CT_NO_OF_CAVITY > 0)t on CT_COMPID= plan.PS_PARENTCOMPID
group by  pd_batchno)prodQ on prodQ.batch=inQ.batch
     order by inwarddt, inQ.batch;

reports.name: Consolidated
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT 
    AP.co_partno AS 'Part No',AP.CO_PARTNAME,AP.CO_WEIGHT,AP.MT_Name,
    
    -- Stock Values (Q1)
    COALESCE(S.stk_1st_Forming, 0) AS '1st Forming (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Electroplating, 0) AS 'Electroplating (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Soapwash, 0) AS 'Soapwash (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Tapping, 0) AS 'Tapping (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_FG, 0) AS 'FG (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_2nd_Forming, 0) AS '2nd Forming (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_3rd_Forming, 0) AS '3rd Forming (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Etching, 0) AS 'Etching (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Deburring, 0) AS 'Deburring (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Laser_Welding, 0) AS 'Laser Welding (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Ultrasonic_Cleaning, 0) AS 'Ultrasonic Cleaning (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Arcor_Coating, 0) AS 'Arcor Coating (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Riveting, 0) AS 'Riveting (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Brazing, 0) AS 'Brazing (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Heat_Sealing, 0) AS 'Heat Sealing (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Dimpling, 0) AS 'Dimpling (Stock)',

    -- Balance Values (Q3)
    COALESCE(B.bal_1st_Forming, 0) AS '1st Forming (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Electroplating, 0) AS 'Electroplating (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Soapwash, 0) AS 'Soapwash (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Tapping, 0) AS 'Tapping (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_FG, 0) AS 'FG (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_2nd_Forming, 0) AS '2nd Forming (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_3rd_Forming, 0) AS '3rd Forming (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Etching, 0) AS 'Etching (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Deburring, 0) AS 'Deburring (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Laser_Welding, 0) AS 'Laser Welding (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Ultrasonic_Cleaning, 0) AS 'Ultrasonic Cleaning (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Arcor_Coating, 0) AS 'Arcor Coating (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Riveting, 0) AS 'Riveting (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Brazing, 0) AS 'Brazing (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Heat_Sealing, 0) AS 'Heat Sealing (WIP Bal)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Dimpling, 0) AS 'Dimpling (WIP Bal)',

    -- QA and Rework (Q2)
    COALESCE(Q.qa_supplier, 0) AS 'QA Pending from Supplier',
    COALESCE(Q.qa_production, 0) AS 'QA Pending from Production',
    COALESCE(Q.qa_disposition, 0) AS 'QA Disposition',
    COALESCE(Q.rework_pending, 0) AS 'Rework Pending'

-- FIX 1: Drive the query off a purely distinct list of Part Numbers
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT co_partno ,CO_PARTNAME,CO_WEIGHT,MT_Name
    FROM components inner join materialtypemaster on MT_Id = CO_MATERIALTYPEID
    WHERE co_partno IS NOT NULL and CO_ACTIVEYN ='Y' and co_id=CO_PARENTID
) AP

-- Stock Values logic inside a LEFT JOIN
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        co_partno AS PartNo, CO_PARTNAME as CO_PARTNAME,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 2  THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_1st_Forming,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 3  THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Electroplating,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 4  THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Soapwash,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 5  THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Tapping,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 6  THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_FG,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 7  THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_2nd_Forming,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 8  THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_3rd_Forming,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 9  THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Etching,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 10 THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Deburring,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 12 THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Laser_Welding,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 13 THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Ultrasonic_Cleaning,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 14 THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Arcor_Coating,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 15 THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Riveting,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 16 THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Brazing,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 17 THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Heat_Sealing,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 18 THEN cs_qty END) AS stk_Dimpling
    FROM (
        SELECT co_partno,CO_PARTNAME, os_id, cs_qty 
        FROM comp_stock 
        LEFT JOIN comp_opstages ON CS_STAGEID = os_id 
        LEFT JOIN components ON CS_COMPID = co_id
        WHERE cs_plantid = {plantid}
    ) t1
    GROUP BY co_partno,CO_PARTNAME
) S ON AP.co_partno = S.PartNo and AP.CO_PARTNAME = S.CO_PARTNAME

-- QA & Rework logic inside a LEFT JOIN
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        co_partno AS PartNo,CO_PARTNAME,
        SUM(QAFromSup_pending) AS qa_supplier,
        SUM(ProdQA_pending)    AS qa_production,
        SUM(qa_disp_pending)   AS qa_disposition,
        SUM(rw_pending)        AS rework_pending
    FROM (
        SELECT CD_COMPID AS comp_id, COALESCE(SUM(QD_OFFEREDQTY), 0) AS QAFromSup_pending, 0 as ProdQA_pending, 0 AS qa_disp_pending, 0 AS rw_pending
        FROM comp_inwardmaster
        INNER JOIN comp_inwarddetails ON CM_ID = CD_CMID
        INNER JOIN qa_details ON QD_CMID = CM_ID
        WHERE CM_PLANT = {plantid} AND QD_STATUS = 'P' AND QD_CRID = 0
        GROUP BY CD_COMPID
        UNION ALL
        SELECT PS_PARENTCOMPID AS comp_id, 0 as QASup_pending, COALESCE(SUM(QD_OFFEREDQTY), 0) AS ProdQA_pending, 0 AS qa_disp_pending, 0 AS rw_pending
        FROM scheduled_production
        INNER JOIN production_details ON ps_id = pd_psid
        INNER JOIN qa_details ON pd_id = qd_pdid
        WHERE pd_plantid = {plantid} AND QD_STATUS = 'P' AND QD_CRID = 0
        GROUP BY PS_PARENTCOMPID
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CR_COMPID AS comp_id, 0 AS qa_pending, 0 as ProdQA_pending, COALESCE(SUM(CR_QTY), 0) AS qa_disp_pending, 0 AS rw_pending
        FROM comp_rejectdetails
        WHERE CR_PLANT = {plantid} AND CR_STATUS = 'P'
        GROUP BY CR_COMPID
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CR_COMPID AS comp_id, 0 AS qa_pending, 0 as ProdQA_pending, 0 AS qa_disp_pending, COALESCE(SUM(CR_QTY) - COALESCE(sum(t2.rdQty), 0), 0) AS rw_pending
        FROM comp_rejectdetails
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT RD_CRID AS crId, SUM(RD_QTY) AS rdQty
            FROM comp_rejinvdetails
            INNER JOIN comp_rejinvmaster ON RD_RJID = RJ_ID
            INNER JOIN comp_rejectdetails ON CR_ID = RD_CRID
            WHERE RJ_MOVEMENT = 'O' AND CR_PLANT = {plantid} AND CR_STATUS = 'R'
            GROUP BY RD_CRID
        ) t2 ON t2.crId = CR_ID
        WHERE CR_PLANT = {plantid} AND CR_STATUS = 'R'
        GROUP BY CR_COMPID    
    ) combined 
    LEFT JOIN components ON co_id = comp_id
    -- FIX 2: Group strictly by Part Number, omitting comp_id 
    GROUP BY co_partno ,CO_PARTNAME
) Q ON AP.co_partno = Q.PartNo and AP.CO_PARTNAME=Q.CO_PARTNAME

-- Balance Data logic inside a LEFT JOIN
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        co_partno AS PartNo, CO_PARTNAME,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 2  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_1st_Forming,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 3  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Electroplating,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 4  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Soapwash,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 5  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Tapping,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 6  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_FG,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 7  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_2nd_Forming,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 8  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_3rd_Forming,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 9  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Etching,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 10 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Deburring,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 12 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Laser_Welding,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 13 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Ultrasonic_Cleaning,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 14 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Arcor_Coating,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 15 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Riveting,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 16 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Brazing,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 17 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Heat_Sealing,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 18 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Dimpling
    FROM (
        SELECT co_id, CO_PARTNO,CO_PARTNAME, cd_opstage, 
               COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cm_movement = 'O' THEN cd_qty WHEN cm_movement = 'I' THEN -cd_qty ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(sum(sd_qty), 0) AS compbalance
        FROM comp_inwardmaster
        INNER JOIN comp_inwarddetails ON cm_id = cd_cmid
        LEFT JOIN comp_opstages ON cd_opstage = os_id 
        LEFT JOIN components ON CD_COMPID = co_id AND CO_ACTIVEYN = 'Y'
        LEFT JOIN comp_scrapdetails ON sd_source='S' AND sd_src=3 AND sd_refno=CD_CMID AND sd_compid = cd_compid AND SD_OPSTAGE = cd_opstage
        WHERE co_id IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY cd_compid, cd_opstage, co_id, CO_PARTNO,CO_PARTNAME
    ) t3
    WHERE compbalance > 0
    GROUP BY co_partno,CO_PARTNAME
) B ON AP.co_partno = B.PartNo and Ap.CO_PARTNAME = B.CO_PARTNAME

-- Exclude blank rows 
WHERE S.PartNo IS NOT NULL 
   OR Q.PartNo IS NOT NULL 
   OR B.PartNo IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY AP.co_partno;

reports.name: Dispatch Distinct
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT
  CU_Name AS Customer,
  CO_partNo AS 'Part No',
  CO_partName AS 'Part Name',
  DATE_FORMAT(CS_DATE, '%d-%m-%Y') AS 'Requested Date',
  sum(CS_QTY) AS 'Requested Qty',
  sum(SD_LOTSIZE) AS 'Dispatched Qty',
  SD_INVOICE AS 'Invoice Number',
  DATE_FORMAT(SD_DISPATCHDATE, '%d-%m-%Y') AS 'Invoice Date'
FROM scheduled_customerdispatch
INNER JOIN scheduled_customer ON SD_CSID = CS_Id
INNER JOIN customer ON CU_Id = CS_CUSTID
INNER JOIN schedule_details ON SC_Id = CS_SCID
INNER JOIN components ON CO_Id = SC_COMPID
INNER JOIN dispatch_status ON DS_Id = SD_Status
WHERE SD_Status = 7
  AND CS_Date BETWEEN {fromDate} AND {toDate}
GROUP BY CU_Name ,CO_partNo ,CO_partName,SD_INVOICE;

reports.name: Current Consolidated Component Stock
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT 
    AP.co_partno AS 'Part No',AP.CO_PARTNAME,AP.CO_WEIGHT,AP.MT_Name,
    
    -- Stock Values (Q1)
    COALESCE(S.stk_1st_Forming, 0) AS '1st Forming (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Electroplating, 0) AS 'Electroplating (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Soapwash, 0) AS 'Soapwash (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Tapping, 0) AS 'Tapping (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_FG, 0) AS 'FG (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_2nd_Forming, 0) AS '2nd Forming (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_3rd_Forming, 0) AS '3rd Forming (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Etching, 0) AS 'Etching (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Deburring, 0) AS 'Deburring (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Laser_Welding, 0) AS 'Laser Welding (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Ultrasonic_Cleaning, 0) AS 'Ultrasonic Cleaning (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Arcor_Coating, 0) AS 'Arcor Coating (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Riveting, 0) AS 'Riveting (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Brazing, 0) AS 'Brazing (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Heat_Sealing, 0) AS 'Heat Sealing (Stock)',
    COALESCE(S.stk_Dimpling, 0) AS 'Dimpling (Stock)',

    -- Balance Values (Q3)
    COALESCE(B.bal_1st_Forming, 0) AS '1st Forming (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Electroplating, 0) AS 'Electroplating (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Soapwash, 0) AS 'Soapwash (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Tapping, 0) AS 'Tapping (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_FG, 0) AS 'FG (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_2nd_Forming, 0) AS '2nd Forming (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_3rd_Forming, 0) AS '3rd Forming (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Etching, 0) AS 'Etching (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Deburring, 0) AS 'Deburring (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Laser_Welding, 0) AS 'Laser Welding (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Ultrasonic_Cleaning, 0) AS 'Ultrasonic Cleaning (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Arcor_Coating, 0) AS 'Arcor Coating (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Riveting, 0) AS 'Riveting (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Brazing, 0) AS 'Brazing (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Heat_Sealing, 0) AS 'Heat Sealing (With Supplier)',
    COALESCE(B.bal_Dimpling, 0) AS 'Dimpling (With Supplier)',

    -- QA and Rework (Q2)
    COALESCE(Q.qa_supplier, 0) AS 'QA Pending from Supplier',
    COALESCE(Q.qa_production, 0) AS 'QA Pending from Production',
    COALESCE(Q.qa_disposition, 0) AS 'QA Disposition',
    COALESCE(Q.rework_pending, 0) AS 'Rework Pending'

-- FIX 1: Drive the query off a purely distinct list of Part Numbers
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT co_partno ,CO_PARTNAME,CO_WEIGHT,MT_Name
    FROM components inner join materialtypemaster on MT_Id = CO_MATERIALTYPEID
    WHERE co_partno IS NOT NULL and CO_ACTIVEYN ='Y' and co_id=CO_PARENTID
) AP

-- Stock Values logic inside a LEFT JOIN
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
    co_partno AS 'PartNo',
    CO_PARTNAME,
    SUM(max_forming_1) AS stk_1st_Forming,
    SUM(max_electro) AS stk_Electroplating,
    SUM(max_soap) AS stk_Soapwash,
    SUM(max_tapping) AS stk_Tapping,
    SUM(max_fg) AS stk_FG,
    SUM(max_forming_2) AS stk_2nd_Forming,
    SUM(max_forming_3) AS stk_3rd_Forming,
    SUM(max_etching) AS stk_Etching,
    SUM(max_deburring) AS stk_Deburring,
    SUM(max_laser) AS stk_Laser_Welding,
    SUM(max_ultrasonic) AS stk_Ultrasonic_Cleaning,
    SUM(max_arcor) AS stk_Arcor_Coating,
    SUM(max_riveting) AS stk_Riveting,
    SUM(max_brazing) AS stk_Brazing,
    SUM(max_sealing) AS stk_Heat_Sealing,
    SUM(max_dimpling) AS stk_Dimpling
FROM (
    -- Level 1: Get the MAX value for each stage, grouped by Plant and Part
    SELECT 
        co_partno,
        CO_PARTNAME,
        cs_plantid,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 2 THEN cs_qty ELSE 0 END) AS max_forming_1,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 3 THEN cs_qty ELSE 0 END) AS max_electro,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 4 THEN cs_qty ELSE 0 END) AS max_soap,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 5 THEN cs_qty ELSE 0 END) AS max_tapping,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 6 THEN cs_qty ELSE 0 END) AS max_fg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 7 THEN cs_qty ELSE 0 END) AS max_forming_2,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 8 THEN cs_qty ELSE 0 END) AS max_forming_3,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 9 THEN cs_qty ELSE 0 END) AS max_etching,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 10 THEN cs_qty ELSE 0 END) AS max_deburring,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 12 THEN cs_qty ELSE 0 END) AS max_laser,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 13 THEN cs_qty ELSE 0 END) AS max_ultrasonic,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 14 THEN cs_qty ELSE 0 END) AS max_arcor,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 15 THEN cs_qty ELSE 0 END) AS max_riveting,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 16 THEN cs_qty ELSE 0 END) AS max_brazing,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 17 THEN cs_qty ELSE 0 END) AS max_sealing,
        MAX(CASE WHEN os_id = 18 THEN cs_qty ELSE 0 END) AS max_dimpling
    FROM comp_stock
    LEFT JOIN comp_opstages ON CS_STAGEID = os_id
    LEFT JOIN components ON CS_COMPID = co_id
    WHERE cs_qty > 0
    and cs_plantid in (1,2)
    GROUP BY co_partno, CO_PARTNAME,cs_plantid
) t
-- Level 2: Sum those plant-specific maximums together
GROUP BY co_partno,CO_PARTNAME
) S ON AP.co_partno = S.PartNo and AP.CO_PARTNAME = S.CO_PARTNAME

-- QA & Rework logic inside a LEFT JOIN
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        co_partno AS PartNo,CO_PARTNAME,
        SUM(QAFromSup_pending) AS qa_supplier,
        SUM(ProdQA_pending)    AS qa_production,
        SUM(qa_disp_pending)   AS qa_disposition,
        SUM(rw_pending)        AS rework_pending
    FROM (
        SELECT CD_COMPID AS comp_id, COALESCE(SUM(QD_OFFEREDQTY), 0) AS QAFromSup_pending, 0 as ProdQA_pending, 0 AS qa_disp_pending, 0 AS rw_pending
        FROM comp_inwardmaster
        INNER JOIN comp_inwarddetails ON CM_ID = CD_CMID
        INNER JOIN qa_details ON QD_CMID = CM_ID
        WHERE QD_STATUS = 'P' AND QD_CRID = 0
        GROUP BY CD_COMPID
        UNION ALL
        SELECT PS_PARENTCOMPID AS comp_id, 0 as QASup_pending, COALESCE(SUM(QD_OFFEREDQTY), 0) AS ProdQA_pending, 0 AS qa_disp_pending, 0 AS rw_pending
        FROM scheduled_production
        INNER JOIN production_details ON ps_id = pd_psid
        INNER JOIN qa_details ON pd_id = qd_pdid
        WHERE QD_STATUS = 'P' AND QD_CRID = 0
        GROUP BY PS_PARENTCOMPID
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CR_COMPID AS comp_id, 0 AS qa_pending, 0 as ProdQA_pending, COALESCE(SUM(CR_QTY), 0) AS qa_disp_pending, 0 AS rw_pending
        FROM comp_rejectdetails
        WHERE CR_STATUS = 'P'
        GROUP BY CR_COMPID
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CR_COMPID AS comp_id, 0 AS qa_pending, 0 as ProdQA_pending, 0 AS qa_disp_pending, COALESCE(SUM(CR_QTY) - COALESCE(sum(t2.rdQty), 0), 0) AS rw_pending
        FROM comp_rejectdetails
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT RD_CRID AS crId, SUM(RD_QTY) AS rdQty
            FROM comp_rejinvdetails
            INNER JOIN comp_rejinvmaster ON RD_RJID = RJ_ID
            INNER JOIN comp_rejectdetails ON CR_ID = RD_CRID
            WHERE RJ_MOVEMENT = 'O' AND CR_STATUS = 'R'
            GROUP BY RD_CRID
        ) t2 ON t2.crId = CR_ID
        WHERE CR_STATUS = 'R'
        GROUP BY CR_COMPID    
    ) combined 
    LEFT JOIN components ON co_id = comp_id
    -- FIX 2: Group strictly by Part Number, omitting comp_id 
    GROUP BY co_partno ,CO_PARTNAME
) Q ON AP.co_partno = Q.PartNo and AP.CO_PARTNAME=Q.CO_PARTNAME

-- Balance Data logic inside a LEFT JOIN
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        co_partno AS PartNo, CO_PARTNAME,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 2  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_1st_Forming,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 3  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Electroplating,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 4  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Soapwash,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 5  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Tapping,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 6  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_FG,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 7  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_2nd_Forming,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 8  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_3rd_Forming,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 9  THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Etching,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 10 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Deburring,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 12 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Laser_Welding,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 13 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Ultrasonic_Cleaning,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 14 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Arcor_Coating,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 15 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Riveting,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 16 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Brazing,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 17 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Heat_Sealing,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd_opstage = 18 THEN compbalance END) AS bal_Dimpling
    FROM (
        SELECT co_id, CO_PARTNO,CO_PARTNAME, cd_opstage, 
               COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cm_movement = 'O' THEN cd_qty WHEN cm_movement = 'I' THEN -cd_qty ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(sum(sd_qty), 0) AS compbalance
        FROM comp_inwardmaster
        INNER JOIN comp_inwarddetails ON cm_id = cd_cmid
        LEFT JOIN comp_opstages ON cd_opstage = os_id 
        LEFT JOIN components ON CD_COMPID = co_id AND CO_ACTIVEYN = 'Y'
        LEFT JOIN comp_scrapdetails ON sd_source='S' AND sd_src=3 AND sd_refno=CD_CMID AND sd_compid = cd_compid AND SD_OPSTAGE = cd_opstage
        WHERE co_id IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY cd_compid, cd_opstage, co_id, CO_PARTNO,CO_PARTNAME
    ) t3
    WHERE compbalance > 0
    GROUP BY co_partno,CO_PARTNAME
) B ON AP.co_partno = B.PartNo and Ap.CO_PARTNAME = B.CO_PARTNAME

-- Exclude blank rows 
WHERE S.PartNo IS NOT NULL 
   OR Q.PartNo IS NOT NULL 
   OR B.PartNo IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY AP.co_partno;

reports.name: Component Production
reports.queryTemplate:
SELECT
  c.CO_PARTNO AS 'Part No',
  c.CO_PARTNAME AS 'Part Name',
  c.CO_WEIGHT AS 'Component Weight',
  mt.MT_NAME AS 'Material',
  os.OS_NAME AS 'Stage',
  cs.CS_PLANTID AS 'Plant',
  cs.CS_QTY AS 'Stock Qty'
FROM comp_stock cs
INNER JOIN components c ON c.CO_ID = cs.CS_COMPID
LEFT JOIN comp_opstages os ON os.OS_ID = cs.CS_STAGEID
LEFT JOIN materialtypemaster mt ON mt.MT_ID = c.CO_MATERIALTYPEID
WHERE c.CO_PARTNO = {partNo}
ORDER BY cs.CS_PLANTID, os.OS_ID;

reports.name: Component Production Details
reports.queryTemplate:
select DATE_FORMAT(pd_date, '%d-%m-%Y') 'ProductionDate', CO_PARTNO 'Part No', PD_LotNo 'Lot No',MCM_Name Machine, CT_TOOLNO Tool, MM_RawMtPartNo 'Raw MAterial',
pd_batchno 'Batch No', pd_prodqty  'No Of Comp', PD_SFREJECT 'SF Rej(Nos)',PD_SWQTY 'SU Wastage(Nos)',PD_SCRAPQTY 'Scrap(Kg)',PD_QTYKG 'Part Wt(Kg)', round(pd_prodqty/conVal,4) 'Theo RM Kg'
from production_details 
left join machinemaster on MCM_Id= PD_MCID
left join materialmaster on mm_id = pd_rmid
left join components_tool on ct_id =pd_toolid
left join scheduled_production on pd_psid= ps_id
left join components on PS_PARENTCOMPID = CO_ID
left join (
SELECT CT_ID AS ctid,
        ((1 / ((MT_Density * MM_Thickness) * MM_StripWidth)) * ((1000 * CT_NO_OF_CAVITY) / CT_Pitch)) AS conVal
      FROM components_tool
      INNER JOIN materialmaster ON CT_RMID = MM_Id
      INNER JOIN materialtypemaster ON MM_MTID = MT_Id
      WHERE CT_ActiveYN = 'Y' AND CT_PITCH > 0 AND CT_NO_OF_CAVITY > 0) toolConv on ctid = ct_id 
where month(pd_date)= EXTRACT(MONTh from current_date) and year(pd_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR from current_date) and CO_PARTNO={partNo}
order by pd_date desc
